event_chain.summary: Phishing link from fake business contact
Stolen credentials used on Microsoft 365 mailbox

summary: IEH Corporation, a U.S. maker of connectors for satellites, fighter jets and the THAAD and Patriot missile programs, disclosed in an SEC 8-K in August 2026 that an employee's Microsoft 365 mailbox was compromised after the employee entered credentials on a fake login page reached from a fraudulent document-sharing link sent by an attacker posing as a prospective business contact. Emails, attachments, customer communications, purchase orders, engineering documentation and possibly export-controlled technical data may have been exposed; IEH found no evidence of exfiltration.
